model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the "effect" (y-axis) of six different language models—mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across nine linguistic families (x-axis): IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The y-axis is labeled "effect" and ranges from 0 to 30 with linear, evenly spaced tick marks at intervals of 10. Each linguistic family has a group of six bars, each corresponding to one model, with colors specified in the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, medium blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, light pink for mBERT-B₂, and dark red for XLM-B₂. Error bars are present on each bar, indicating variability or confidence intervals. The bars are arranged in the order of the linguistic families from left to right, with no apparent sorting by height. The highest effects are observed in the IE-Indic family, where mBERT-R₂ (light green) reaches approximately 20, XLM-R₂ (dark green) reaches about 18, and mBERT-B₂ (light pink) and XLM-B₂ (dark red) reach around 23 and 21, respectively. In contrast, the Uralic family shows very low effects across all models, mostly near 0. The Semitic family also shows relatively high effects, with mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ reaching approximately 15 and 20, respectively. The IE-Germanic and IE-Slavic family groups show moderate effects, with some models reaching up to 15–17. The Isolate family consistently shows minimal effects, with all bars close to 0. The chart does not highlight any specific bars or categories with additional visual emphasis.
